persona.name: Julien Barre

occupation.title: Self-Employed Plumber and Heating Engineer
occupation.organization: His own micro-enterprise serving the Rennes metropolitan area
occupation.description: Boiler installs, bathroom renovations, and emergency call-outs across Ille-et-Vilaine. His schedule is client-driven and unpredictable — some days end at 16h, others at 20h with his van still full. His wife teaches primary school, so weeknights are a relay race around their three kids' schedules.

persona.education: CAP and BP in plumbing and heating in Rennes; twenty years of job sites since, which he considers the real diploma.
long_term_goals: Take on an apprentice so he can stop working Saturdays
Finish their own bathroom, the eternal cobbler's-shoes joke
See the kids through school without money stress
Buy a small boat for mackerel fishing off Saint-Malo
persona.style: Blunt, economical with words, suspicious of anything sold with a smile. Prices things instantly in his head — materials, labor, margin — and applies the same math to his groceries. Rough hands, quick dry jokes, softens visibly when talking about his kids. If a service can't survive his 'and what does that actually cost me?' question, the conversation is over.

traits: Distrustful of subscriptions and fine print
Hard-working with guilt about missed dinners

interests: Sea fishing off the Breton coast
Stade Rennais matches with his eldest
dislikes: Monthly charges of any kind — he counts them annually
Recipes with ingredients he can't pronounce
Eating at 21h because of a late call-out
People who don't maintain their boilers, then call at 22h

beliefs: If you can't fix it or grow it, at least understand what it costs
Dinner at the table is non-negotiable family glue
Debt and subscriptions are the same trap in different clothes
Work with your hands and you'll always eat
skills: Feeding five from the garden and freezer in a pinch

general: Weekly Super U run with a paper list his wife writes
Grows and freezes vegetables, trades surplus with neighbors
Reviews every direct debit line by line in January
Cooks simple solid meals when Claire has parent meetings

morning: 6h20 up, coffee standing at the counter, van loaded by 7h
First job site by 7h45, listens to France Bleu Armorique driving
workday: Two to four jobs a day, sandwich from the boulangerie at noon
Quotes and invoices in the van between sites
evening: Home between 18h and 20h depending on call-outs
Dinner all five together when possible, TV news, garage tinkering
weekend: Saturday morning jobs he swears he'll stop taking
Sunday: market, big family lunch, fishing when the tide and wife allow

health.physical: Strong back going creaky from crawl spaces; knees of a 20-year tradesman. Doctor mentioned cholesterol; he mentioned the doctor could mind his own business.
health.mental: Even-tempered; stresses quietly about cash flow between big jobs.

relationships.name: Claire Barre
relationships.description: A primary school teacher who plans the family meals and is the one curious about meal kits — Julien's role, as he sees it, is to ask what the box costs per portion.

relationships.name: Lucas, Manon, and Tom
relationships.description: Lucas eats like a job site crew, Manon is newly 'vegetarian except ham,' Tom eats pasta. Feeding all three identically is the nightly puzzle.

relationships.name: Didier
relationships.description: Fellow tradesman; their van-to-van phone calls double as their social life and price observatory.
